faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.q1: Is DawaiBuddy a replacement for my doctor?
faq.a1: No. DawaiBuddy helps you understand your medicines in plain language, but it never replaces professional medical advice. Always confirm changes with your doctor or pharmacist.
faq.q2: How accurate is the prescription scanning?
faq.a2: Our OCR is trained on Indian prescriptions, including handwriting, and shows a confidence score for every medicine. You can review and correct any detail before saving.
faq.q3: Is my health data private and secure?
faq.a3: Yes. Your prescriptions are encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold, and you can delete your data at any time.
faq.q4: Does it work with Indian medicine brands?
faq.a4: Absolutely. We index over 1.2 million Indian medicines and brands, with salt composition, dosage forms and generic alternatives.
faq.a5: Core features — scanning, plain-language info and reminders — are free forever. Plus unlocks family profiles and advanced tools.
